description: SCOUT's flood simulation, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Simulate Flood node projects flood depth over the Quad Cities for a period, with nature-based solutions where a cell's class is one of those chosen and without them elsewhere, as a raster an Autark map draws.
name: SCOUT Flood Simulation

templates.description: SCOUT's flood projection: for each cell, the flood depth with nature-based solutions (NbS) where its class is one of the solutions chosen, and without them elsewhere. Input: (classes, nbs, no_nbs), three rasters on one grid: the NbS classes and one period's flood depth with NbS and without, as data.scout.quad-cities-flood holds them. Output: one RASTER of flood depth in metres, NaN where the projection gives none, for an Autark map, Raster Statistics or Compare Scenarios.
templates.label: Simulate Flood
